speaker: (narration)
current_text: THE SPECIAL SAUCE

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Delicious. Compulsory. Do not ask what is in it.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: It is in everything now. Please enjoy.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: THE SPECIAL SAUCE (RECALLED)

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Contents: a lot of things that were not food. Return all unused sauce to the Pantry.
new_text: Return unused Special Sauce to the Pantry. Its ingredients have failed to establish that they are food.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: TASTE TESTERS WANTED

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Join the elite food-safety force. Free uniform, free meals, no questions.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: (Previous taste testers are available for questions. They are not answering.)

speaker: (narration)
current_text: TASTE TESTERS: THANK YOU

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The taste testers are free. They like food again. Please give them seconds.

speaker: (narration/UI)
current_text: Well Fed

speaker: (narration/UI)
current_text: Nobody leaves hungry, least of all the Gourmands. Full bellies make for strong golems.

speaker: (narration/UI)
current_text: Dress Code Violation

speaker: (narration/UI)
current_text: The Gourmands look down their noses at garbage eaters. Refusemancers here feel very, very underdressed.
new_text: The Gourmands insist on formal dining; Refusemancers arrive dressed for the work that grew the dinner.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: The Grand Chef
current_text: Have you eaten? Sit. I am the Grand Chef, and forgive the apron: the impostor kept it cleaner, but I wear it with feeling.

speaker: The Grand Chef
current_text: Ten years in the walk-in freezer, and I never once forgot the taste of honest soup. They put that sauce in every pot and called it innovation.

speaker: The Grand Chef
current_text: Innovation is a pinch of something new in something good. It is not a cannon.

speaker: The Grand Chef
current_text: Thank you for finding me. Now eat.

speaker: The Grand Chef
current_text: Let me cook for you. I promise there is nothing in it but food.

speaker: The Grand Chef
current_text: And you, my dear: you do not know your name yet. Good. That is not a flaw, it is a blank page. Go and do something worth signing.

speaker: (check key)
current_text: THE GRAND CHEF (OFFICIAL LIKENESS)

speaker: (check key)
current_text: "Innovation Is Delicious."

speaker: (check key)
current_text: FORMER LIKENESS OF THE DOPPELGANGER

speaker: (check key)
current_text: (It was always a little off. Whose chin is that?)
new_text: Official likeness withdrawn. It never captured the person who fed us.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: (UI)
current_text: The Test Kitchen

speaker: (UI)
current_text: Test kitchens, food labs and an enormous, unfinished cannon. Somewhere inside, the Grand Chef is not the Grand Chef. HP carries in from the zone; only the canteen heals. Beat the boss to free the Buffet.

speaker: (UI)
current_text: The Test Kitchen is quiet now, and the real Grand Chef is cooking. You can still run the prototypes for gold and XP. HP carries in from the zone; nothing heals except at the canteen.

speaker: (UI)
current_text: Enter the Test Kitchen

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Loading Dock

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Crates of ingredients roll in. Crates of something else roll out, and they are not labelled.
new_text: You pass incoming ingredient crates and outgoing unlabelled ones. Research appears to be a one-way conversation.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: A sign over the dock doors reads TASTE-TESTER ENTRANCE. Beneath it, in smaller letters: NO EXIT.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The air smells of caramel and solder. Somewhere deep inside, a cannon coughs and a dozen chefs say "Yes, Chef!" very quietly.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Ingredient Intake

speaker: (narration)
current_text: A corrupted sous-chef guards the conveyor belt. Everything on the belt is a little too shiny.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Taste Panel

speaker: (narration)
current_text: A panel of grim judges tastes whatever you can serve them. Their verdict is final. So is their silence.
new_text: You face a silent panel of grim judges. They taste your dishes as though flavour might be used against them.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Cold Storage Prototypes

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Frozen failures line the walls. Some of them are still moving. One of the freezers is humming louder than the rest.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Staff Canteen

speaker: (narration)
current_text: A hot meal, an honest one. The only unmodified food in the building. Restore HP.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The cook behind the counter whispers: "The Grand Chef stopped tasting her own soup ten years ago. Nobody noticed. Everybody noticed. Nobody said."

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Food Construct

speaker: (narration)
current_text: An experimental food construct, stitched together from three kinds of meat and one regret. (Elite)

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Cannon Bay

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The unfinished war machine looms. It is enormous, held together by gravy and willpower.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Armory Pantry

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Shelves of rations, ladles and ladle-shaped weapons. Take what you can carry.
new_text: You find rations, ladles and ladle-shaped weapons. Take what you can carry; someone has overthought serving suggestions.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Special Sauce Vats

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Great vats of the Special Sauce bubble in the dark. This is where the corruption is made.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: You pour a vat out. Behind it, a service door opens on the Executive Test Kitchen. The air there smells like a very expensive soup that nobody has ever tasted.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Mk. IX Prototype

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The finest war machine the Test Kitchen has ever failed to finish. It is armed, hungry and unseasoned. (Elite)
new_text: You face the Test Kitchen's finest unfinished war machine: armed, hungry and still awaiting seasoning. (Elite)
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Whistleblower

speaker: (narration)
current_text: A sous-chef hiding in the dry goods wants to tell you something about the Grand Chef.

speaker: The Doppelganger, later Escoffina
current_text: The Executive Test Kitchen

speaker: The Doppelganger, later Escoffina
current_text: The Grand Chef's private kitchen. Her apron is spotless. Her chin is a little off.

speaker: The Doppelganger, later Escoffina
current_text: The Grand Chef turns from the stove. She smiles the smile from every portrait in the Pantry. She has worn it for ten years without a crease.

speaker: The Doppelganger, later Escoffina
current_text: "Ah. A taste tester. Welcome to the future of dining. The future is efficient. The future does not need to be tasted."

speaker: The Doppelganger, later Escoffina
current_text: The Doppelganger collapses, and the Special Sauce goes with it, down a drain in the floor. Somewhere in the walls, a freezer door swings open on its own.

speaker: The Doppelganger, later Escoffina
current_text: Ten years of frost pour out, and with them a woman in chef's whites: upright, blinking and furious.

speaker: The Doppelganger, later Escoffina
current_text: The golems straighten up. "Yes, Chef!" they say, and this time they mean the right one.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Taste Panel

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Four dishes are served to the panel. They want to see that you can field real, living units, not just soup.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Cannon Bay

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The unfinished war machine fills the room: a cannon the size of a barn, fed by a conveyor belt of meatballs. A tired engineer in an apron asks whether you are here for the inspection or for the tour.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Take the blueprints (and a tip)

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Jam the cannon's gravy valve

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Eat one of the test meatballs

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The engineer slips you the blueprints and a few coins. "Please burn these," he whispers. "After you're done selling them."

speaker: (narration)
current_text: You twist the valve. The cannon coughs, sighs, and settles into a sulk. Your units feel sturdier in a kitchen that is slightly less likely to fire at them.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Surprisingly good. It is a prototype, so it is also a little bit explosive. You feel a lot better, and a little singed.
new_text: You eat the prototype meatball and feel much better, if slightly singed. The aftertaste has a blast radius.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Whistleblower

speaker: (narration)
current_text: A sous-chef is hiding behind the sacks of flour. "She does not taste the soup," he whispers. "She never tastes the soup.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Chef ALWAYS tastes. Whoever is in that kitchen is not our Chef."

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Take his notes on the impostor

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Share your rations with him

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Turn him in for the reward

speaker: (narration)
current_text: He presses a stained notebook into your hands: habits, weak spots, and a very detailed list of everything the impostor will not eat. The list is everything. Your units hit harder.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: He eats like a man who has not eaten in a week. "Thank you," he says. "Be careful.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The real Chef is down there somewhere. I know she is." You feel better for it.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The guards pay well and ask no questions. You feel terrible. Possibly it is the Special Sauce. Possibly it is not.
new_text: The guards pay you without a question. You pocket the coins and feel sick.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: The Grand Chef
current_text: Ten years in a freezer, and I can still tell you what is wrong with this soup. Everything. Everything is wrong with this soup.
new_text: Ten years in a freezer, and I still remember what this soup should taste like. Let me put it right.
writer_note: Restoration beat: culinary authority without a punchline over captivity.

speaker: The Doppelganger
current_text: I do not know what to call myself. Your name was the only one I had, and now it is yours again.

speaker: The Doppelganger
current_text: I have no name. I have no face. I do not even have a flavour.
new_text: I have no name or face of my own. I cannot even taste what I make.
writer_note: Keeps lost identity and inability to taste, without the flavour gag.

speaker: The Wanderer
current_text: How do you prove who you are to a kitchen that has eaten the same lie for ten years?
new_text: How will they know it's you? After ten years?
writer_note: Wanderer asks plainly rather than delivering a thematic speech.

speaker: The Grand Chef
current_text: Not with a speech. Not with papers. With dinner.

speaker: The Grand Chef
current_text: Stand back, all of you. Somebody get me flour, butter and the biggest oven in this building.

speaker: The Endless Buffet
current_text: The dish is plain, golden and enormous. It smells of butter and bread and somebody's grandmother's kitchen.
new_text: Before you sits a plain, golden dish, large enough to share. You smell butter and warm bread.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: The Endless Buffet
current_text: The first bite breaks the enchantment all through the Endless Buffet.

speaker: The Endless Buffet
current_text: Signs flicker back to honest words, glazed chefs blink at their own hands, and a thousand golems lower their ladles.
new_text: You watch the chefs blink at their hands. Across the Buffet, a thousand golems lower their ladles.
writer_note: Keeps visible release; removes words appearing on world art.

speaker: The Grand Chef
current_text: Come here, you. No face, no name. What you are called does not matter. What you do is what matters.

speaker: The Grand Chef
current_text: And you have been the best-behaved prisoner in my kitchen for five whole minutes.
new_text: You have been my prisoner for five minutes, and you have given me no trouble. Let me give you something in return.
writer_note: Keeps five-minute good-conduct beat and transition to the gift, without the wink.

speaker: The Grand Chef
current_text: So take my old name. Escoffina. I was always prouder of the work than of the title.

speaker: Escoffina
current_text: ...Escoffina. I will try to cook honestly. I will try to be someone worth the name.

speaker: The Doppelganger, later Escoffina
current_text: Escoffina. Apprentice. Second class.

speaker: The Doppelganger, later Escoffina
current_text: Third, if you count the dishes. Chef says what I am called does not matter, only what I do. So I am doing a great many dishes.

speaker: The Doppelganger, later Escoffina
current_text: I made a sauce today. A real one. I tasted it. As me. It had too much salt.

speaker: The Doppelganger, later Escoffina
current_text: Everyone ate it anyway and said it was a good start. I did not know people could be so kind about salt.

speaker: The Doppelganger, later Escoffina
current_text: I have a face of my own now. I am still deciding what to do with it. I am trying.
